scripts.dev: npm run core:build && npm -C electron run dev
scripts.core:install: npm run core:build && mkdir -p electron/bin && cp core/clovapi electron/bin/clovapi && chmod +x electron/bin/clovapi && echo Installed local clovapi to core/clovapi and electron/bin/clovapi
scripts.core:install-global: npm run core:build && sh -c 'target=$(command -v clovapi); test -n "$target" || exit 1; rm -f "$target"; cp core/clovapi "$target" && chmod +x "$target" && echo Installed to "$target"' && npm run core:install
